title: Post-Construction Cleaning in Abuja: Why Moving Into a New Home Without It is a Risk
excerpt: Don't move into dust and debris! Discover why professional post-construction cleaning is essential for your family's health and your home's longevity.

children.text: Congratulations on your new home! Whether it's in Karsana, Gwarinpa, or Lokogoma, those fresh walls and gleaming fixtures are a dream come true. However, before you unpack your first box, there's an invisible threat you need to know about.
CRITICAL HEALTH WARNING: Why 'Just Sweeping' Isn't Enough

Construction dust isn't like regular house dust. It's a toxic cocktail of fine silica (from tile and concrete cutting), paint fumes, chemical solvents, and sharp debris like glass shards or hidden nails.

body.name: faq
body.question: Can't I just do this myself with a broom and mop?
body.answer: We strongly advise against it. Household vacuums often blow fine silica dust back into the air, and removing cement haze requires specialized chemicals that can damage your tiles if used incorrectly.
